# Poké Ball variety credits

- **Pokeballs 1-st Pack** — DoubleTrouble (https://sketchfab.com/AJLENb). [Original source](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/pokeballs-1-st-pack-abbf5216c6a44b70a7a26d35ced8e1c1). Declared license: CC-BY-4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
- **Set of 4 Pokéballs** — damien_max59 (https://sketchfab.com/damienbouchez59). [Original source](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/set-of-4-pokeballs-b1c99e62332340c5bf46f74eefc07902). Declared license: CC-BY-4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

All ten supplied variants are represented. Modifications: transforms baked; fronts aligned and each variant centred and grounded at normalized height; constant colours baked in linear-sRGB vertex colours; source gloss/emission replaced by a shared matte material. Dense surfaces were selectively simplified while retaining raised emblems. Garden placements share geometry and materials.
